config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-02: CQL - Types - Clinical. SKEPTIC pass covered Code, CodeSystem, Concept, ValueSet, and Vocabulary clinical type behavior across translator output and DuckDB native/forced-fallback execution.

issues.title: Code selectors and named code references lost CQL Code shape
issues.evidence: Fresh probes showed `Code '8480-6' from LOINC is Code` translated through JSON resourceType extraction over the legacy string `http://loinc.org|8480-6`, raising malformed JSON, while `ToConcept(Code '8480-6' from LOINC)` returned NULL in both DuckDB native and forced Python fallback paths.
issues.resolution: Code selectors, named code refs, and codesystem-qualified code refs now translate to JSON-shaped CQL Code literals with code/system/display fields. Concept refs now translate to JSON-shaped CQL Concept literals.
issues.verification: fhir4ds/cql/duckdb/tests/integration/test_clinical_type_parity.py passed on native and forced Python fallback; official CQL conformance passed 1706/1706.

issues.title: Clinical `is` checks fell through to FHIR resource-type probing
issues.evidence: Clinical literals and references such as `System.ValueSet{id: '123'} is Vocabulary`, named value sets, named concepts, and code selectors needed static CQL clinical type identity rather than FHIR JSON `resourceType` extraction.
issues.resolution: Added static clinical type detection for Code, Concept, ValueSet, CodeSystem, and Vocabulary and evaluated those before the generic FHIR resource-type path.
issues.verification: Clinical type parity tests assert translation and execution results for ValueSet/CodeSystem as Vocabulary, Code as Code, Code not Concept, named Code/Concept/ValueSet refs, and code selectors.

issues.title: Clinical `as` assertions accepted mismatched clinical types
issues.evidence: `System.ValueSet{id: '123'} as CodeSystem`, `Code { code: '8480-6' } as Concept`, and `Code '8480-6' from LOINC as Concept` returned source values instead of NULL.
issues.resolution: Clinical `as` now behaves as a type assertion: exact clinical type matches pass through, Vocabulary accepts only ValueSet and CodeSystem, and mismatches lower to SQL NULL.
issues.verification: Native-loaded and forced Python fallback DuckDB connections now agree on NULL for mismatched clinical assertions and JSON output for valid Vocabulary/Concept results.

issues.title: Static clinical `as` remediation regressed dynamic FHIR clinical assertions
issues.evidence: Architect validation caught a DQM regression: full conformance dropped DQM to 39/47 because dynamic FHIR expressions such as `Observation.value as Concept ~ "Stage"` were statically lowered to NULL/FALSE when the source clinical type was not known at translation time.
issues.resolution: Clinical `as` now short-circuits only when the source expression has a statically known clinical type. Unknown or dynamic FHIR values fall through to the existing runtime assertion path so CodeableConcept/Concept comparisons still generate code matching SQL.
issues.verification: Clinical type parity pytest passed 5/5; targeted DQM measures CMS646, CMS1056, CMS826, and CMS122 passed 4/4 at 100%; broad CQL unit/integration/DuckDB pytest passed 4894 with 5 skips; full conformance passed 2822/2822.
